    • calculateConnectionStrength

      public int calculateConnectionStrength(Student other)
      Calculates the connection strength between this student and another student. Connection strength is based on: roommate (+4), shared internships (+3 each), same major (+2), same age (+1).
      Specified by:
      calculateConnectionStrength in class Student
      Parameters:
      other - the other student to compare with
      Returns:
      the total connection strength
